# DJ Orestis

> Greek DJ based in Brussels, playing weddings, corporate events and private parties across Belgium and Europe. Trained in the nightlife of Mykonos, resident DJ at Papillon Schuman. More than ten years of events.

Bookings cover Belgium and travel across Europe. Sound and lighting can be supplied with the booking, and live musicians and singers can be arranged alongside the DJ set, from Belgium or from Greece.

Announcements at events are made in English and Greek, and in Bulgarian. Written enquiries are also welcome in French and Dutch.

The site is published in English, French, Dutch and Greek; the English pages are listed here and each one links to its translations.

## Services
- [Corporate event DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/corporate-event-dj-brussels/): Corporate event DJ in Brussels: receptions, staff parties, product launches and business events for companies including Freshfields and BCG. Professional, discreet, full sound & light available. Belgium & Europe.
- [Wedding DJ in Brussels & Belgium](https://djorestis.com/wedding-dj-brussels/): Wedding DJ in Brussels and across Belgium for Greek, international and mixed weddings and baptisms. Tailored playlists, ceremony to last dance, sound & light included if needed. Also NL, FR, DE, UK, GR.
- [Greek DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/greek-dj-brussels/): Greek DJ in Brussels: authentic Greek nights for communities, associations and private celebrations across Belgium and Europe. Host of the Brussels Greek Food Festival, resident at Papillon Schuman.
- [Balkan & Bulgarian DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/balkan-dj-brussels/): Balkan and Bulgarian DJ in Brussels: pop-folk, chalga, Greek laika and international sets for Bulgarian, Serbian, Macedonian and Romanian communities across Belgium. Hosting in Bulgarian.
- [Party DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/party-dj-brussels/): Private party DJ in Brussels: birthdays, anniversaries, graduations and celebrations with a professional open-format DJ. Electronic, Afro, Latin, RnB and Greek. Sound & light available. Belgium & Europe.
- [Full-package event solutions](https://djorestis.com/full-package/): One partner for your whole event in Brussels and beyond: professional DJ, sound and lighting for up to 500 guests, plus photography and video. One contact, one setup, one invoice.
- [Resident DJ for restaurants & bars](https://djorestis.com/restaurant-dj-brussels/): Hire a resident DJ for your restaurant or bar in Brussels. Recurring themed nights that fill quiet weekdays and lift bar revenue. Four-year residency at Papillon Schuman. Pilot night available.
- [Greek DJ across Europe](https://djorestis.com/greek-dj-europe/): Book a Mykonos-trained Greek DJ for destination events across Europe: weddings, corporate events and Greek parties in the Netherlands, France, Germany, the UK and Greece, including Mykonos itself.

## About and contact
- [About DJ Orestis](https://djorestis.com/about/): DJ Orestis: 3 years in Mykonos nightlife, 6 years in Brussels, resident DJ at Papillon Schuman and co-founder of Sounds Greek Events. Corporate events, weddings and Greek parties across Europe.
- [Services](https://djorestis.com/services/): Professional DJ services in Brussels and across Europe: corporate events, weddings and baptisms, Greek parties, private celebrations, plus full sound, light, photo and video packages for up to 500 guests.
- [Six music worlds, one DJ](https://djorestis.com/music/): The six music worlds DJ Orestis mixes: Greek, Balkan, electronic, Afro, Latin and RnB, how a set is actually built, and what that means for weddings, corporate events and Greek nights.
- [Past events & residencies](https://djorestis.com/events/): Selected events by DJ Orestis: Papillon Schuman residency, Brussels Greek Food Festival, corporate events for Freshfields and BCG, Greek community parties in Vienna, Leuven, Lille and Luxembourg, Mykonos guest sets.
- [Request a quote](https://djorestis.com/contact/): Book DJ Orestis for your corporate event, wedding or party in Brussels, Belgium or anywhere in Europe. Fill in the quote form and receive a personalised proposal, usually within 48 hours.
